brief:
# Console commands over API, MCP and CLI (Urgent, Opus)

Brett Nov 3 2026 07:16 ET (voice): add console commands to the MCP, the API and the CLI so he can tell Amber (a Claude session) to load screens for him.

Based on claude/token-control (control@1 contract, PR #246). A sibling build `token-control-opus` (branch claude/token-control-opus) is building the token/AmberX/planner API, MCP and CLI right now: fetch it and build on its server/MCP/CLI layout if it exists, and merge origin/main + that branch before the PR. Don't duplicate its work.

Do:
1. control@1 `console` namespace: open a view/screen (by id, title or search), open a dialog, open a settings tab/sub-tab, run any registered action, go back, list available screens/actions (so Claude can find the right one).
2. Live delivery: the open console in Brett's browser receives the command and navigates right away (reuse Watch live / `axf focus` channel if it fits; one target per signed-in user, all his open consoles or the most recent). Also Molly and AmberX web if the same runtime makes it cheap; say in the PR what's covered.
3. REST API endpoints, MCP tools (registered through axHub so this voice/Claude session can call them), and CLI: `axf console open <screen>`, `axf console action <id>`, `axf console list`.
4. Safety: navigation and opening only; running an action that changes data needs the same approval policy as the action itself.
5. Tests, check-theme/check-controls, help pack, interactive docs entries, UI Review shots if anything visible changes.

Rules: one session, no sub-agents. Tokens only (--fx-*), framework controls, no var() fallbacks. Add a THREADS.md row (profile urgent) and update each step. Commit + push branch claude/console-commands often; open the PR at the end (push banner merges it). In the PR, say exactly which axHub tool names a Claude session calls to load a screen.

steps.text: control@1 console namespace: console.screens/dialogs/settings/actions/nav/clients targets, navigate effect + permission, schema snapshot, fixtures
Pure engine framework/core/engines/console-commands.mjs: catalog, resolve by id/title/search, action effects, delivery message, runner for the console domain
Token control runner: console domain through a context (catalog + clients) handed in by the console server
console-commands plugin server: per-user mailbox, SSE stream, hello/seen/ack, console-commands@1 capability, /api/console REST
Browser client library: stream, catalog publish, run commands through rt.search.focus / dispatch, back history, toast
MCP console_* tools (registered through axHub) + CLI axf console open|dialog|settings|action|back|list
Settings sub-tab, help pack, interactive docs entries
Tests (engine, runner, server), check-theme/check-controls, plugin-lifecycle check, UI Review shots, THREADS, PR
